cases.answer_sketch: Accumulator air pre-charge 1450 psi on the gauge rig.

cases.question: What strut pressure acceptance reference does the landing gear uplock assembly inspection card state?
cases.answer_sketch: Strut pressure 615 psi at 21 °C (simulated reference value).

cases.question: Which acceptance value does the APU fire extinguishing bottle inspection card give for bottle pressure?
cases.answer_sketch: Bottle pressure 1250 psi, read within the green band.

cases.question: Which seal kit part number is referenced for the temperature trim air valve?
cases.answer_sketch: The tools and equipment section lists the seal kit part number with its supplier.

cases.question: Fault code FC-2974-514 — what does it indicate and which task isolates it?
cases.answer_sketch: FC-2974-514 maps to the hydraulic reservoir pressurization module (slow response after start).

cases.question: What component does fault code FC-2158-874 point to?
cases.answer_sketch: The temperature trim air valve (fails to respond to command).

cases.question: Fault code FC-3616-225 meaning
cases.answer_sketch: Pressure regulating valve — out-of-range reading on the related display.

cases.question: Which fault isolation task covers FC-2817-718 for audible noise during operation?
cases.answer_sketch: The fuel transfer jet pump fault isolation task.

cases.question: FC-3282-237 — vibration reported by the crew on the nose landing gear shock absorber
cases.answer_sketch: That fault code maps to the nose landing gear shock absorber vibration report.

cases.question: Which task isolates fault code FC-2697-357 (warning message after power-up on the fire detection loop)?
cases.answer_sketch: The engine fire detection loop element fault isolation task.

cases.question: No output at the related sensor from the electrical essential bus feed breaker — what fault code and task apply?
cases.answer_sketch: FC-2491-131, isolated by the electrical essential bus feed breaker task.

cases.question: APU start contactor intermittent indication — which fault code does the TSM assign?
Standby attitude module fails to respond to command — fault code and isolation task?
cases.answer_sketch: FC-3463-796, covered by the standby attitude module fault isolation task.

cases.question: Rudder trim actuator intermittent indication — which TSM fault code applies?
After the isolation steps all pass, which component does the TSM say to replace for the hydraulic reservoir pressurization module fault?
cases.answer_sketch: Replace the hydraulic reservoir pressurization module and repeat the operational check.

cases.question: How do I clear fault code FC-2158-874 and verify rectification?
cases.answer_sketch: Clear FC-2158-874, operate the affected system through the stated cycles, verify the symptom does not return.

cases.question: First isolation action for the pressure regulating valve out-of-range reading
cases.answer_sketch: Connect the test set and confirm the fault code is active, then bite the pneumatic circuit for a reproducible symptom.

cases.question: Which IPC figure lists the hydraulic accumulator parts?
cases.answer_sketch: Figure 29-45-01-F1, item 01 — hydraulic accumulator (simulated parts list).

cases.question: Where do I find the parts list for the gear actuating cylinder assembly?
cases.answer_sketch: IPC figure 32-14-05-F1 and following figures list the assembly parts.

cases.question: Which illustrated parts figure covers the pitch trim motor clutch?
cases.answer_sketch: Figure 27-37-09-F1 lists the aileron/pitch trim assembly parts — item 01 is the pitch trim motor clutch.

cases.question: Which SB applies to the hydraulic reservoir pressurization module fleet improvement and what line numbers does it cover?
cases.answer_sketch: SB-29-002 applies to NX-320 line numbers 40–118 not incorporating the stated modification status.

cases.question: SB-29-002 Rev 02 supersession — what changed relative to Rev 01?
cases.answer_sketch: Rev 02 supersedes Rev 01, extends the accomplishment interval and adds the post-modification operational check.

cases.question: How many flight hours to accomplish the side stay pin inspection interval extension bulletin?
cases.answer_sketch: Within the stated flight-hour interval of the effective date, whichever comes first with the next scheduled check.

cases.question: What does the AOA vane connector seal replacement bulletin apply to?
cases.answer_sketch: SB-34-003, applicable to the stated NX-320 line numbers not incorporating the modification.

cases.question: Bleed duct clamp collar re-torque campaign — accomplishment interval and torque
cases.answer_sketch: Accomplish within the stated flight hours; torque the new attach hardware to the stated value and apply torque seal.
